scenario: Real 64x64 GDI capture with full-region privacy mask, 1 FPS; lifecycle and persistence validation, not a motion benchmark.
memory_note: Host + worker RSS sum includes shared pages; not unique physical memory.
fixed_during_acceptance: Rounded total-duration boundary created an unpublished empty part header in .work; prevent next-part allocation and remove empty stages.
Cross-connection duplicate requests must not report a live recording as terminal or start another worker.
Low-FPS checkpoint writes must retain the held source until the next sample/boundary, avoiding shortened intermediate parts.
Disk accounting uses Windows enumeration metadata to tolerate asynchronous temporary-file rename/deletion.
limits: Each GIF is at most 300 seconds; capacity/metadata/decoder budgets can rotate sooner.
Checkpoint target is approximately five seconds, not zero-loss power-failure protection.
Normal EOF saves. Forced host/worker termination requires recovery. Detached capture is not implemented.
